blog_title: Discharge Printing on Dark T-Shirts — Does It Add Ink or Remove Fabric Dye? How It Works
caption: Dark T-shirt discharge printing removes dye, not adds ink. 🎨 A chemical destroys your fabric's ground colour, leaving white where the design prints. Add a dye the chemical can't affect, and a new colour appears instead. But here's the catch: not every dark shade discharges cleanly without damage. Always confirm with your printer first—don't assume any dark tee will lift properly. Have you checked with your supplier if your chosen fabric colour can actually be discharged? 💭
